svg.title: Hyouga Yui — Nine Hells Frozen. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Ice classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Permafrost Heart forks into Weight of the Avalanche then Buried in the Avalanche, or Deepening Frost then The Glacier Advances. Cocytus Vigil forks into Cracks in the Ice then Nine Hells Opened, or Rime Mantle then Locked in Cocytus. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Ice jutsu.

Avalanche 40 \u2192 43 EP), or +10% on both self buffs (Avalanche, Glacier's Will)","secondary":"Control of the exchange (Cocytus Vigil): +10% exposure on Cocytus's target and Spear's circle, or +10% Every capstone carries one tag","rationale":"Permafrost Heart answers \"How do I make my Ice strikes land harder: crack them for heavier strikes, or stoke my own window?\": Weight of the Avalanche marks Spear's circle and Cocytus's target and Buried in the Avalanche adds raw Damage to every strike on every cast; The Glacier Advances raises both 2-round self buffs. Cocytus Vigil answers \"How do I control the exchange: open them to every blow, or shut us off from theirs?\": Nine Hells Opened deepens both marks to 45%, Locked in Cocytus guards the caster and the allies on Glacier's Will's tiles. Flat Damage stops at +3 because the strikes sit at 45/45/40 EP and +5 would turn both 45s into 50 Nukes and the 40 into a 45. Wound, shield and move are unsupported. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Ice jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Descent Cocytus · Will · Hell's Spear (4 effects)
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Buried in the Avalanche path + Cocytus Vigil
The Glacier Advances path + Cocytus Vigil
Nine Hells Opened path + Permafrost Heart
Locked in Cocytus path + Cracks in the Ice
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE HYOUGA YUI KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
